title: Coruscant Guard
caption: Coruscant Guard (Dark) (V)
game_text: Heroic. Deploys -1 to Senate. While at Senate, Sidious is cumulatively politics +2, and, during your control phase, may place this character in Used Pile to ▲ {ovs} Expand The Empire or take any one card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle.
lore: Coruscant Guards are an elite force whose assignments include the protection of important political figures, as well as the policing of Coruscant’s higher profile city districts.

notes: Group: Imperial Senate (DARK SIDE). Non-unique (no dot). Bottom-half slip. The bottom strip prints 'Coruscant Guard (Dark) (V)' (caption); the heading above the slip 'Coruscant Guard (V)' (heading). Stats POWER 3 / ABILITY 2; the THIRD stat box is printed EMPTY (blank black box, no label — as on the printed card); deploy 3 / forfeit 4 (printed POWER 2 / ABILITY 1, deploy 2 / forfeit 4). INLINE: ▲ then a blue sphere before 'Expand The Empire' = the VS16 set sphere (matched against the slip's own sphere; Expand The Empire (V) is VS16 #44) → {ovs}; the stub drops the sphere and expands ▲. Icon column: warrior (blue, blaster) only. Affiliation Republic (Coruscant Dark frame, Republic crest disc; wiki subtype Republic). Printed card carries the Coruscant ring + Episode I icon → ring_icons ['episode1']. Lore matches the wiki; curly apostrophe in Coruscant’s (straight on the wiki; curly on the 745 px V17 face). Copyright '© 2001 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2001 DECIPHER INC.' read off the scan. Base Cor-D-coruscantguard.gif 350 px.
